API: OutputDelivery: bounded credit and idempotent absolute delivery-prefix acknowledgements over the original output record
checks: PASS partial delivery, one-token fallback credit, duplicate commit and pending-once continuation
PASS bounded credit, idempotent prefix acknowledgement and atomic invalid-extent rejection
review: Independent read-only review found no material defect under the single-owner contract; model integration remains unimplemented.
first_revision: Count-based acknowledgement compiled and passed its checks. Review improved it to an absolute prefix so duplicate/older acknowledgements cannot consume another pending token. Both revisions and both actual host runs are retained.
contracts: Owner validates RequestKey before routing delayed events and always passes current actual generated.size(), never a stale event extent.
Credit preflight does not reserve another episode: the original model permits only one in-flight episode per request.
Model commit observation and successful output delivery are separate cursors; output completion does not reset turn progress or RNG.
Partial delivery exposes only actual freed credit; a narrower supported MTP/ordinary episode must be chosen when needed.
Completed requests retain undelivered final output until drain or an explicit discard policy; model completion alone is not slot release.
The existing bounded output record is borrowed, never copied into a second queue.
limits: No Model/GPU/online entry/backpressure scheduling integration run.
No throughput or memory performance claim.
CMake registration is added but this check invokes the retained compiler directly, not a CMake configure/build.
